name: Roj Kurdish Calendar
description:
The Kurdish solar calendar in your top bar. Roj means both sun and day in Kurdish.

Click the date for a full calendar: every day shows the Kurdish day, with the Gregorian, Persian and Islamic days beside it, and the selected day's events.

• Sorani, Kurmanji, English, Persian and Arabic, right to left where needed
• Each calendar in its own digits: Persian ۰۱۲, Islamic ٠١٢, Gregorian 012
• Sorani ezafe (ی) and traditional month names
• 43 Kurdish days included, from Newroz to Halabja; add your own JSON events or any .ics calendar, such as your country's public holidays
• A dot, count or title in the top bar when today has an event, red on holidays
• Separate fonts for Latin and Arabic-script text: Manrope, Vazirmatn, Estedad, Sahel or your own
• Any strftime pattern for the top bar and popup, with live previews
• Date converter, built-in guide, light, dark and system themes, settings backup
• The roj command for the terminal

Guide with screenshots: https://0xdolan.github.io/roj/guide.html
Live calendar in your browser: https://0xdolan.github.io/roj/calendar/
